decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement A.2.4a, B.EX.0.1, B.EX.0.2, B.EX.2.1, B.EX.2.4, B.EX.3.1, B.EX.3.2, B.EX.3.3, B.EX.3.4, B.EX.4.2, B.EX.4.3, D.PR.0.1, D.PR.2.1, D.PR.2.4, D.PR.3.1, D.PR.3.2, D.PR.3.3, D.PR.3.4, D.PR.4.2, and D.PR.4.2a received: 02/02/2018. Flood Risk Matrix and B.EX.4.4 received: 06/02/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the timber panels to be used in the construction of the cladding of the existing rear extension hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of an infill single storey rear extension, new external cladding at rear ground floor, and replacement windows to the house.
